title: typikon page
description: Frontmatter contract for a typikon-consuming site's standard page (content/<name>.md, not _index.md).

title.description: Page title. Renders as <title> and <h1>. Keep under ~50 chars for SEO.

description.description: SEO meta description and og:description. Aim for 120-180 chars.

date.description: ISO 8601 date. Required for journal entries; optional otherwise.

updated.description: ISO 8601. When this page was last meaningfully edited.

path.description: Override Zola's auto-generated path. Lowercase ASCII, slashes, hyphens, underscores.

seo_title.description: Override <title> when it should differ from page title (e.g., longer SEO-optimized form).

body_class.description: CSS class on <body>. Used by the home page to hide nav/footer (body_class = 'home-page').

og_image.description: Path under static/ (e.g. 'img/og-cover.png'). get_url() resolves to absolute.
